text:
Marta (Finance): Echo Systems sent invoice ECHO-1100 for $6,125 but Coupa auto-matched it to PO 1100 (internal test). Vendor insists PO 1100-2025 was issued. Due in 5 days.
Ava (ProcureOps): Upload the invoice PDF and vendor portal screenshot. This looks like a PO prefix collision weve seen before.
invoicer-bot: Invoice ECHO-1100 uploaded by supplier id 9922 (auto-match confidence: 0%). Note: PO 1100 exists as internal test PO.
Echo-AR (vendor): Hi team, we issued PO 1100-2025 from our buyer. AR phone +1-206-555-0199. They need payment confirmation to avoid suspension.
Sam (VendorOps): Attached vendor portal export and PO metadata. Supplier tax id 66-1234567.
Priya (Ops): This was ordered by my team (PR-1100-DEMO) but procurement never finished the handoff. It was escalated incorrectly to an internal test PO number.
Ava (ProcureOps): Options: (1) Create retro PO 1100-2025-retro and remap supplier id 9922; (2) Ask vendor to reissue invoice referencing existing internal PO (not ideal). Need legal ack before retro.
Harper (Legal): CLM shows SOW signed by vendor but no countersignature. I can provide a commercial ACK if vendor sends an email accepting Redwood standard T&Cs.
Echo-AR (vendor): We can confirm T&Cs via email now. Sending acceptance.
Marta (Finance): Bank last4 4433 verified. Vendor requests late fee waiver if paid within 48 hours.
Lina (Payments): We can queue a 50% expedited payment after Finance marks matched and approvals are present. Remainder on final match.
Ava (ProcureOps): Ill create PO 1100-2025-retro and add note: "Prevent numeric collision; retro PO to clear ECHO-1100." Routing: Priya -> Harper -> Marta.
invoicer-bot: PO 1100-2025-retro created (status: pending approvals).
Harper (Legal): Received vendor T&C acceptance. Providing commercial ACK now.
Priya (Ops): Approved. Ill also add a note in PR-1100-DEMO to avoid reuse of short PO numbers.
Ava (ProcureOps): Supplier mapping updated in Coupa to lock PO range 1100-1105 to supplier id 9922.
Marta (Finance): Marking invoice matched. Please queue payment.
Lina (Payments): Queued 50% for expedited sweep tonight; remaining 50% held until final closure.
Sam (VendorOps): Vendor notified and thanks given. Will follow up to ensure mapping prevents future collisions.
Marta (Finance): Closing loop  will monitor for final PO close and release remaining funds. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
